subject: general
question: In certain code language, HONEY is coded as 8-12-13-5-2. How will PATCH be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b907857577a77a8a434a44ac1d162fc3010997ea3e916db5aeb300d07efa412.png] The logic followed here is:

 
• Unit digit place value → Same
 
• Double-digit place value → Opposite letter place value

The code for HONEY will be as follows:

HONEY → 8 -12 - 13 - 5 - 2. 

 
• Unit digit place value → Same
 
• Double-digit place value → Opposite letter place value

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/edf2652226f358506bed45bc059073c91626f4e298e7190f68934cb0e18521ee.png] 

Similarly,

PATCH = ?

 
• Unit digit place value → Same
 
• Double-digit place value → Opposite letter place value

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/393e59fdda228e5e654b56ae0688441c1dcc32db0cbb6233382d5c6e7056c8aa.png] 

Hence, The code for "PATCH" will be "11 - 1 - 7 - 3 - 8".
